   script_debug_writes disable
   
   script_variables
      # Current task
      double task_interrupt_interval = 480;
      double current_task_receive_time = -99999;
      # attack_target
      Array<WsfWeapon> attack_weapons;
      # attacker_retreat_to_mother_ship
      WsfPlatform mother_ship;
      Array<int> weapon_refill_quantity;
      # chase_air_target

      double minimum_cruise_distance; # m
      # evade_threats
      Array<WsfWeapon> evade_weapons;
      WsfThreatProcessor threat_processor;
   end_script_variables
   
   on_message 
      type WSF_TASK_ASSIGN_MESSAGE
         script 
            WsfTaskAssignMessage m = (WsfTaskAssignMessage) MESSAGE;
            if (m.Track().IsValid() && m.Track().Target().IsValid() && !m.Track().TargetKilled()) {
               if (TIME_NOW >= current_task_receive_time + task_interrupt_interval || 
                  !PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().IsValid() || PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().TargetKilled()) {
                  PLATFORM.SetCurrentTarget(m.Track());
                  current_task_receive_time = TIME_NOW;
               }
            }
            writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " has received task (" + m.Track().TargetName() + ") from " + m.AssignerName());
         end_script
   end_on_message
   
   on_update
      if (PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().IsValid() && PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().TargetKilled()) {
         PLATFORM.ClearCurrentTarget();
      }
   end_on_update
   

   

   behavior_tree 
      selector 
         behavior_node attacker_retreat_to_mother_ship
         parallel
            behavior_node evade_threats
            selector 
               behavior_node cruise
               behavior_node chase_air_target
            end_selector
            behavior_node attack_target
         end_parallel
      end_selector
   end_behavior_tree
